_quarto:

The circle on an annotated code line must have the same size as the circle in the annotation list.
The probe measures the width of every circle, and the compile fails when two widths differ.

```{=typst}
#let radii = state("circle-radii", ())
#show circle: it => {
  context { let w = measure(it).width; radii.update(r => r + (w,)) }
  it
}
```

```python
x = 1 # <1>
y = 2 # <2>
```

1. First.
2. Second.

```{=typst}
#context {
  let all = radii.final()
  assert.eq(all.len(), 4, message: "expected 4 circles, 2 on the code lines and 2 in the list")
  assert(all.all(r => r == all.first()), message: "circle widths differ: " + repr(all))
}
```
